dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and consistent geometric narrowing from the mid-body region toward the posterior peduncle, resulting in a streamlined triangular profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are largely smooth and symmetrical; a slight shadowed indentation is visible on the right lateral margin corresponding to the pectoral fin junction.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with high-intensity luminance; lower-intensity light-grey tones are confined to the shadowed regions of the posterior peduncle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, circular dark-pixel void at the anterior dorsal position representing an open blowhole.
